A Bit About Me

I'm a product designer with 7 years of experience shipping digital products used by millions. I started in graphic design, transitioned to UX through a bootcamp, and have been obsessed with interaction design ever since.

When I'm not pushing pixels, you'll find me hiking in Marin, collecting vinyl records, or volunteering as a design mentor for underrepresented students.
